issues.label: Merger of credit card counts into robbery
issues.why: Court must determine whether unlawful acquisition of credit cards merges into aggravated robbery under statutory or common-law merger principles.

issues.label: Single vs. multiple credit card charges
issues.why: Whether taking three cards in one transaction supports three separate unlawful acquisition counts or one unit of prosecution.

issues.label: Aggravated robbery basis (car keys)
issues.why: Whether taking the car keys satisfies the elements of aggravated robbery as charged.

issues.label: Sufficiency of aggravated sexual assault evidence
issues.why: Whether the evidence supports the two counts given the consent dispute.

issues.label: PSI inaccuracy findings required
issues.why: Utah law requires the court to make findings on alleged PSI inaccuracies raised by defense.

issues.label: Waiver of PSI corrections
issues.why: Whether counsel's 'that's it' response preserved or waived the objections to the PSI errors.

issues.label: Preservation of merger argument on appeal
issues.why: Whether the merger issue was adequately raised below to preserve it for review.

issues.label: Consecutive vs. concurrent sentencing factors
issues.why: Court must properly weigh statutory factors (gravity, number of victims, history, rehabilitative needs) for consecutive sentences.

issues.label: Consideration of defendant's age/effective life sentence
issues.why: Whether the court adequately considered that consecutive terms create a de facto life sentence.

issues.label: Reliance on defendant's lack of remorse/testimony
issues.why: Whether penalizing Connelley for maintaining his non-credible account implicates his rights.

issues.label: Double jeopardy multiple punishments
issues.why: Whether cumulative punishments for overlapping conduct violate double jeopardy protections.

issues.label: Mandatory minimum interests-of-justice finding
issues.why: Whether the court properly applied the interests-of-justice standard for the fifteen-to-life sexual assault sentence.

issues.label: Reliance on potentially inaccurate PSI at sentencing
issues.why: Whether the court improperly relied on disputed PSI statements in imposing sentence.

issues.label: Sufficiency of aggravated assault (strangulation/knife)
issues.why: Whether evidence supports aggravated assault as a distinct offense.

issues.label: Proportionality of sentence
issues.why: Whether the aggregate sentence is constitutionally proportionate to the offenses.
